title: Ultimate Eleven has a trailer!
author: Remote-History-6458
selftext:
I made a small trailer of my Ai assisted soccer game, i wasn't gone! I was just working on it!

The game is fully developed by one person with the help and use of Ai, claude opus and openai astra did most of the heavy-duty obviously cause I'm not a game developer and this is the first time i make a game!

The character in field for now only differ for hairs colors and team kit but I'm working on make all the hairstyles to match the duels sprite, same goes for the gk

Hopefully I'll be able to wishlist this game soon on steam and we'll see how that goes

To the one that have followed this journey from the beginning I say thank you for the support and to the redt I say thank you for the feedback of my latest video!

replies.author: Remote-History-6458
replies.body: I hope to wrap up soon a demo on steam!
